# Signatories

## Project team

**Uwakmfon Usen Paul, MLS**: R Programming Instructor at the Ghana R Users Community

**GitHub**: <https://github.com/DevWebWacky>

I will be the sole developer delivering this project. I am proficient in R and Python. I have so far built and maintain 4 R packages and 1 python package, two (R) of which has been published in CRAN, one pending final approval, and one in development stage. Below are the packages: 

- **triageR** (CRAN): a clinical prediction modelling package aligned with TRIPOD+AI reporting standards, including an optional AI-assisted layer for method recommendation. 

- **statease** (CRAN): runs statistical tests and generates plain-English explanations of the results automatically. 

- **rgrind** (pending CRAN approval): a gamified R learning tool, reflecting my interest in making R more approachable.

- **cystimap** (Development stage): an R package for reproducible spatial risk mapping.

- **rpynative** (PyPI): rpynative lets Python developers load and use R packages as if they were normal Python packages. No R syntax, no manual object conversion, and unlike other R-Python bridges, rpynative supports real IDE autocomplete and rich Jupyter/Colab display for R functions.
